segments.ja328:1.1: Bahūnaṃ vijjatī bhotī, tehi me kiṃ bhavissati;
segments.ja328:1.3: Tasmā etaṃ na socāmi, piyaṃ sammillahāsiniṃ.
segments.ja328:2.1: Taṃ taṃ ce anusoceyya, yaṃ yaṃ tassa na vijjati;
segments.ja328:3.1: Na heva ṭhitaṃ nāsīnaṃ, na sayānaṃ na paddhaguṃ [patthaguṃ (syā.)];
segments.ja328:3.3: Yāva byāti nimisati, tatrāpi rasatī [saratī (sī. syā. pī.)] vayo.
segments.ja328:4.1: Tatthattani vatappaddhe [vata panthe (syā.), vata bandhe (ka.) vata + pa-addhe = vatappaddhe], vinābhāve asaṃsaye;
segments.ja328:4.3: Bhūtaṃ sesaṃ dayitabbaṃ, vītaṃ ananusociyanti [cavitaṃ nānusociyanti (syā.), matantaṃ nānusociyaṃ (ka.)].
